I am building an edge AI healthcare assistant for low-power Android devices that can perform real-time medical image classification and lightweight multimodal reasoning offline.

- run on devices with maximum 1GB RAM
- maintain inference latency below 120ms
- support offline inference with no cloud dependency
- prioritize quantized or pruned models
- support TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, GGUF, or llama.cpp compatibility
- work efficiently on ARM/mobile chipsets
- support future deployment on Raspberry Pi and Jetson Nano

I need:

- lightweight vision-language models
- medical image classification models
- edge-compatible LLMs
- repositories with active maintenance and recent commits
- recent research papers related to TinyML, edge inference, quantization, and healthcare AI

Prioritize:

- HuggingFace models with high downloads and recent activity
- GitHub repositories with strong community adoption
- models optimized for mobile or embedded deployment
- trending edge AI research

Avoid:

- cloud-only models
- models requiring GPU servers
- very large parameter models (>7B unless quantized)
- inactive or outdated repositories

Also provide:

- deployment feasibility analysis
- compatibility score
- trend analysis
- optimization suggestions for low-latency edge deployment
- reasoning for why each recommendation fits my constraints
